week_overview: Hey! So for Week 1, it looks like a lot of the action is centered on anytime touchdown props, with 374 edges out there. Phil Mafah stands out with the strongest edge, followed closely by Tory Horton and Darren Waller, all looking pretty promising for a TD. It's interesting to see that there's not really any strong confidence plays hitting above 80%, which has me feeling like the lines are tighter this week overall. Unfortunately, no arbitrage opportunities are popping up, so it's more about finding those well-researched plays. Keep an eye on the TD props, especially with those guys; they could bring some fun returns!
